title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Catastro - CadastralProperty
description: Real estate property registered in the Cadastre: a premises, dwelling, or any independent use unit within a parcel (edintcat:CadastralProperty, subclass of geosparql:Feature). A cadastral property may have one or more constructions associated.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CadastralProperty'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

onCadastralParcel.description: Relationship. The CadastralParcel this property is located on -- exactly one (edintcat:onCadastralParcel).

hasCadastralConstruction.description: Relationship. The constructive unit(s) that make up this property (edintcat:hasCadastralConstruction).

hasClass.description: Property. Classification of the property, from the Clase controlled vocabulary (edintcat:hasClass).

hasUse.description: Property. Primary use of the property, from the Uso controlled vocabulary (edintcat:hasUse).

hasAddress.description: Relationship. The property's address (edintcat:hasAddress), in the external callejero:Portal vocabulary (not modeled by this candidate).

participation.description: Property. Percentage of participation in common elements of the property (edintcat:participation).

hasHorizontalDivision.description: Property. Whether the property is subject to horizontal division regime (edintcat:hasHorizontalDivision).

hasGeometry.description: Relationship. Reference to the property's geometry (geosparql:hasGeometry); see CadastralParcel.hasGeometry for the modeling rationale.
